notes.text: The opening paragraph says that the bouchage operations are relatively superficial: at fixed g they do not relate the indicated objects to ones with smaller g. It points instead to erasing the cutting circles, labelled by the source’s raised circled 5°. The written numeral is retained; no cross-page renumbering is imported from H’s editorial note.

The next paragraph asks to make explicit the fundamental groupoids Pi_1(X;R) of the displayed triples, with the nonempty base-point condition and functorial dependence on R. The short form p^ts-base is preserved. The curved condition leader fixes its attachment after the baseline base-point phrase, while en tant que remains baseline text.

The rewritten passage speaks of every finite-set representation of the groupoid, an associated covering X-prime of X, and a new object of the displayed S T category. The author says that the question is already nontrivial for S_2 T_{0,3}, then calls the demand perhaps too ambitious. The page ends at car, leaving that reason unfinished. The cancelled predecessor, initial letters of the raised defining phrase, and de/des remain explicitly uncertain.

The margin says that the displayed Sigma is formally empty and ends with working in S T_top^± instead of S T D_top^±. Its middle wording is compressed and stays doubtful. The two category names and au lieu de were read directly; H’s inclusion symbol is unsupported. The larger groupoïdes on the right of the margin crop belongs to the main paragraph and is not repeated in the note.

Three long curved strokes function as attachment leaders under raised additions: Pi_1(X;R), the nonempty condition, and the defining phrase. No matching opening parentheses are manufactured from their curved left ends. The literal opening square bracket before the defining phrase is retained without an invented closing bracket; the source closing parentheses after opération and X are retained.

Every agreed main word and formula was compared on the original and prepared halves, then all differing words and resolved C doubts were inspected on enlarged crops. The original and each half were displayed once. Seventeen distinct places produced nineteen saved and actually viewed evidence files; the two additional files are targeted extensions of the still-open margin, not rereadings of settled text. No OCR, web reference or TeX compilation was used.

The initial five-image crop-view attempt returned a wholly truncated result, with no displayed image available for inspection. Those images were then successfully displayed in smaller batches; the nineteen recorded views count actual inspections, not the failed output. The pale lower 63 is recorded without attributing its hand.

The preceding operations list on scan 061 labels erasing cutting circles as 4, while this leaf explicitly gives the raised circled 5°. The clear numeral is preserved as a cross-reference mismatch rather than silently harmonized. The insertion state of that unchanged numeral, the empty-set glyph form, and the abbreviation are not counted as changes of mathematical content.
